title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Compositionality
abstract: arXiv:2610.29722v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external knowledge. Modern pipelines combine embedding, chunking, retrieval, reranking, query augmentation, context compression, and agentic verification, yet these techniques are typically evaluated one at a time. It remains unclear whether their isolated gains survive composition, whether retrieval quality and answer faithfulness favor the same design choices, and whether conclusions from small corpora hold at large scale. We pre-declare three hypotheses and introduce LASAGNA, an open-source framework for controlled RAG evaluation. We test 450 configurations across eight benchmarks and corpora ranging from 5K to 200K documents. Three findings emerge. First, individually strong techniques from different phases of a RAG pipeline do not necessarily compose: three retrieval techniques predict a +47% combined improvement but deliver only +17% when used together. translated_title: 检索增强生成的组合性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.29722v1 公告类型：新 摘要：检索增强生成（RAG）将大语言模型建立在外部知识之上。现代RAG流程结合了嵌入、分块、检索、重排序、查询增强、上下文压缩和智能体验证等技术，但这些技术通常只是被单独评估。目前尚不清楚它们各自带来的增益在组合后是否仍然成立，检索质量和答案忠实度是否偏好相同的设计选择，以及从小型语料库得出的结论在大规模场景下是否依然有效。我们预先声明了三个假设，并引入了LASAGNA——一个用于受控RAG评估的开源框架。我们在八个基准测试上测试了450种配置，语料库规模从5千到20万篇文档不等。研究得出三个发现。首先，来自RAG流程不同阶段的单独表现优异的技术不一定能够良好组合：三种检索技术预测组合后可带来+47%的提升，但实际同时使用时仅带来+17%的改进。其次，c……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出开源受控RAG评估框架LASAGNA，通过对450种配置、八个基准的大规模实验发现，RAG流程中各阶段的强技术在组合后增益无法叠加（预测+47%实际仅+17%）。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LASAGNA, an open-source framework for controlled RAG evaluation, and shows through 450 configurations across eight benchmarks that individually strong RAG techniques do not necessarily compose—a predicted +47% combined improvement yields only +17% when used together.
